newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX natgas resumes climb to new highs late.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX natgas resumes climb to new highs late.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures continued to march higher late Wednesday in active trade, with more panic short covering and supportive weather forecasts underpinning the complex, industry sources said.

December rallied 32.4 cents late to another contract high of $3.63 per million British thermal units before backing off to $3.61 by 1450 EST. January, which early hit a new high of $3.34, was 12.5 cents higher at $3.295. Others also were up.
"People (shorts) are panicking. It looks like we're still going higher but at these prices, you're going to lose industrial and utility load," said one Midwest trader.

Most agreed revised forecasts this week calling for mostly below-normal U.S. temperatures through the month helped set a more bullish tone for bidweek and triggered the rally, which has seen December rally 37 percent in the last five sessions to the highest spot futures price since December 21, 1995.
Chartists pegged next December resistance at the all-time spot continuation intraday high of $3.72 from last December. Support was seen at $3.10 and then at $2.88.

Cash sources said Gulf Coast prices jumped almost 40 cents to the high-$3.30s. Midwest pipes gained a similar amount to the low-to-mid $3.20s. New York city gate swing gas also was up almost 40 cents to near the $4 level, with December in New York quoted at $1.30-35 over the NYMEX screen.
NYMEX said 65,362 Hub contracts traded at 1420 EST.
NYMEX December Hub natgas expires Thursday, November 21.
NYMEX December Alberta natgas was still up by 20 cents at $1.95 after early setting a new high of $2.00. NYMEX said 33 Alberta contracts traded at 1155 EST.
NYMEX Permian natgas remained untraded at 1450 EST but December was bid 50 cents higher at $3.45.
On the KCBT, December surged 55.5 cents to a new high of $3.605, while deferreds were up by eight to 10 cents. The East/West spread narrowed by 27.6 cents to two cents (KCBT premium).
